Mum's Old Photos: 看妈妈小时候的老照片。
This evening, Mum opens a big old book. It is full of photos. They are photos of Mum when she was a little girl.
In one photo, Mum is five years old. She stands in front of a small house in the countryside. She wears a red dress and has short hair.

In another photo, Mum rides a big black and white dog! We all laugh. Mum says the dog's name is Lucky, and he is her best friend. Grandma makes delicious cakes, Mum adds, but there is no phone or TV at that time.
